The node detects, the root relieves, the relief expires: a node MAY self-report config:load (infra:attest, witness_relation self, expires_at, about itself only) and MAY always reduce its own optional work; it MUST NOT author mesh_config, which is the trust root's plane over other nodes. Both TTL-bounded because the TTL attaches to unilateralness

CC 3.4.5 self-or-owner for config:* is enforced at SUBSTRATE ADMISSION (CC 3.4.7 leg one), not producer obligation alone — a third-party config:* about a node it does not own is refused at the put door (persist v38.7.0 ships check_config_self_or_owner_admission; the manifest does not yet publish it)

session:* — occurrence self-report (attesting==attested==the occurrence) with convergent merge (earliest claimed_at, ties on lowest occurrence key_id); an unclaimed exchange is NEVER acted on, not even by a single-occurrence self; attendance is presence in the table, no weak-claim variant; projection ceiling Cohort with no authority branch (Global would publish an attendance map of a person's devices)

Nobody joins a family or community without their own consent, under every consensus_protocol incl. founder_only: a proposal (inviter; K in subject_key_ids; required expires_at ≤ 30 d; no quorum) → K's acceptance (references_attestation_id + proposal_hash + role) → a widening judged under consensus_protocol, admitted only on a matching, undeclined, unexpired acceptance on signed instants; a supersede never adds; a founding record seats exactly the listed members who signed it; named membership_* refusals; reverse quorum is not a membership rule

Within-cohort custody reports: custody:ack:v1, per device per blob, custody_state here | none signed by the device itself (a signed none is a custody fact), at the blob's own cohort_scope, replicated only within the cohort, the ONE holding claim at every tier (holds_bytes retired, #141): placed at the content's scope, federation for Commons/public where the here rows are the holder directory; audience from the CC 6.1.5.3 rule; never a content binding; retracted by its signer alone; freshness is the row's expires_at; live 72 h, re-acknowledged about daily, older reads unknown; per-device view here / received (5.3.3.6) / none / unknown, unknown never shown as none; no possession challenge yet: a here report is trusted as signed (challenges deferred to CIRISPersist#976)

file:v1 registered; collection:directory:v1 is a sealed object with a stable id carried by supersedes; membership is parent inside the child's sealed descriptor (no edge row; tree shape sealed at every scope; a move is one write); promotion is one intent executed as N per-file crossings with the tripwire, no folder key; directory scope is a default never a floor; a directory promotion widens only the promoter's own files

Fountain coding, the target-replication model and anti-entropy are standard at every tier: pull anti-entropy on the one carrier for every row and blob a node is audience for (self/family among the cohort's own nodes); FountainHoldingClaim and custody:ack at every tier, bounded to the content's own cohort at self/family; target_holders counted over the audience, full-blob holding on every audience node below N+K, the §R-policy tuple at or above it; rarest-first, repair, pin-on-consent at every tier; consent supreme; anonymous tier exempt (SR-2)

A cohort's audience is claimed nodes only (every node is claimed before normal mesh operation, and every owned node is one of its owner's devices); a node's role at setup sets its default allow list (personal = all the owner's cohorts; server = only the cohorts it serves, so the owner's self/family content does not follow); the allow list is a missing grant on the existing replication check (consent:replication for the node + no content key wrap), enforced at sender and receiver; self rows that originate on the node and self rows that refer to it (owner-binding, key record, config, grants, budget, revocation) always reach it, so remote administration works; each cohort sees only its own projection; the allow list is the optional cohorts member of the owner's consent:replication grant for the node (no separate policy row); absent, a personal device receives every owner cohort and a server node no self/family content, class from the device_class of the node's identity_occurrence (personal = phone|laptop; server = server|embedded|service|agent); cohorts entries are {scope, target}, self never listed, empty = explicitly none

Self-report routing: cohort_scope is per-row and never family-pinned (sensitive leaves self; operational leaves the smallest scope reaching peers that route to them); an emission grant (infra:attest) confers no right to be believed and is never an input to a receiver's trust set — admissible but unweighted, weighting is consumer policy; a renewal MUST carry supersedes so the live set is one row per (subject, scope, leaf) and composers count distinct subjects, never rows

Licensure / grant / delegation are three concepts with three wire discriminators (dimension prefix, subject_kind, structural primitive). Only DELEGATION chains — a licence confers no power to issue one, a grant no power to re-grant — so only delegates_to gets a graph walk; a design that walks a licence or grant transitively has mistaken it for a delegation. Provenance is the authority_id, conferred by quorum, never by delegates_to; a key_grant is non-transferable by default (an onward grant is a NEW grant by a key-holder, enforced cryptographically before policy)

license and grant delegated_scope kinds with ENFORCED ADMISSION: an issuance whose delegator does not itself hold the underlying authority (licence authority for that authority_id; the asset for a grant) is refused at admission, not merely unweighted

infra:attest MAY be attenuated to a dimension family (infra:attest:licensure:{authority_id}) as a caveat on an existing capability, adding no member to the closed infra:* set. Matching is DIRECTIONAL: a parent satisfies a check for its child, a child MUST NOT satisfy a check for its parent, and an unrecognized sub-scope MUST NOT widen to its parent — a starts_with test hands a narrowed holder the full capability

licensure:{authority_id} status vocabulary widened to issued/probation/restricted/suspended/revoked/lapsed/surrendered/reduced; suspended is REVERSIBLE and revoked is TERMINAL (a consumer MUST honour the distinction and MUST NOT infer one status from another); more than one status MAY be live concurrently, so a consumer composes the set rather than reading a scalar

duty:{kind} — an obligation attached to a permission (the ODRL Duty leg a permission/prohibition grammar cannot express, and what every widely-used content licence rests on). Canonical kinds follow ODRL 2.2; a duty STATES the obligation, discharge is evidenced by the existing commitment_fulfillment, breach routes to hard_case:duty_unmet (adjudication, never automatic slashing). Rides scores; no new structural primitive

R3: dimensions are case-sensitive byte strings compared byte-exactly, never case-folded; per-segment classes (literal/vocab/external/value/hex) carried as data in families[].segments and _meta.case_rule; vocab segments MUST match [a-z0-9][a-z0-9_.-]* and are refused (namespace_dimension_case_malformed) otherwise; unclassified placeholder fails the build

Anyone may be a licensing authority under their own key; authority_id names a key (or an org resolving via org_membership); licensure rows admit under the ordinary trust-or-consent gate, no authority roster; the (subject, A) fold takes only rows whose emitter resolves to A (A's key or a license chain to A) — other rows are testimony, admitted but outside the fold; the one refusal is licensure_delegator_not_authority on a license-scoped issuance whose chain does not resolve to A; no bootstrap (A signs its own first row)

An organisation is an affiliation and names itself as an authority by its community_key_id (the org_id of the retiring record), through which its keys resolve under its consensus_protocol; the three 3.3.9 kinds move onto affiliation rows on the adopting release

The scope of a consent:state:granted is the scope member of that row's own envelope (bare string or token array, sub-scoping in the token); no fold reads a consent:scope:{kind} companion row, which is descriptive only; analyze is binding on emission for federation-tier capacity:* via the CC 3.4.5 consent-before-scoring gate (#46)

consent:decay:{stage} is emitted by the party running the decay protocol (the CEM for the CIRISAgent 90-day decay), as a self-report per CC 3.4.5.1; the substrate emits no decay row, its own leaf is consent:state:expired

Multimedia Source struct: format is the IANA media-type essence (RFC 6838, lowercase, no params); codec is an RFC 6381-family id in its own field, REQUIRED for video/mp4 and audio/mp4; size REQUIRED and checked before the digest; captions on video/film is the sha256 of a separate text/vtt blob; AI disclosure value space is IPTC Digital Source Type; no multicodec, no CID layer, evidence_refs stays bare sha256; the struct carries no safe/renderable/tier bit; renditions are separate blobs with derived_from, sender canonicalises before hashing, node stores verbatim

A CCC decides whether and how to render from the verified bytes and its own policy, never from a descriptor claim; after full-SHA it sniffs the leading bytes and requires sniffed essence == declared format, mismatch is a refusal not a correction; declared format/codec are inputs to comparison and capability checks, never authorisations; the Tier A/B/C table is recommended CCC policy, not normative; SVG bytes are Tier C and a node MAY emit a Tier-A PNG rendition

live_stream (Phase 2) shape recorded: HLS/CMAF over fragmented MP4 per RFC 8216; init segment is the per-epoch sha256-addressed header, each chunk an independently hashable fMP4 segment ordered by sequence, codec stream-level; init || chunk0 || chunk1 ... is a valid video/mp4 so a recording is an ordinary video blob with derived_from: stream_id; stream manifest is an OCI-index-shaped chunk-descriptor list cited from evidence_refs; SHA-256 has no tree mode so verified streaming is manifest-of-chunk-hashes

Every descriptor citing a blob from evidence_refs[] carries the byte length alongside the digest (known at creation); the consumer compares received length to declared size before computing the digest and refuses on mismatch without reading the rest; size is the cheaper check that runs first, never a substitute for the digest; a live stream in progress is the one descriptor without a total, its chunks and init segment each carry one

A person's public device roster is exactly the nodes whose owner-binding is carried at cohort_scope: federation (announcing = the owner re-signing the binding at that audience); the transport announce of a node key places nothing on the roster; a self-only binding is never enumerated to a node outside the owner's self cohort; nodes_owned_by(U) as seen by a stranger yields exactly the announced set

When no direct path exists a scoped body MAY ride the members' E2E identity-plane link through a non-member transport node, the room discriminated inside the link encryption and admitted against the same address table; nothing about the derived address is emitted or retained; the intermediary's only role is reachability (path request + link establishment, link brought direct where it can be, ciphertext relay otherwise, nothing naming the room); derived address preferred whenever a direct link exists; what is conceded is CC 1.13.3.1's non-goal
A node whose owner resolves to the minor band MUST NOT carry a federation-scope owner-binding; admission refuses the promotion (CC 3.4.13 Q5 composed with 5.4.6)

Every scored dimension carries exactly one trailing :v{N} version segment after its family's segments; matching strips it; absence refuses missing_version_segment; exempt families (attestation ladder, canonical binding) need none; the rule is manifest data (_meta.case_rule.version_segment) and every consumer replays namespace_match_vectors.json

A reserved wildcard family publishes its named leaves and is closed: any other leaf is namespace_family_unregistered; accord:* admits exactly the six registered leaves; a closed vocab enumeration refuses an unlisted value with namespace_vocab_value_unregistered

invocation_kind is constitutional | notify | drill, byte-exact and lowercase, under the domain label ciris.accord_invoke.v2; a signature under the v1 label fails verification; the accord heartbeat is accord:lifecycle (wire accord:lifecycle:v1) and accord:lifecycle:active is the resumption kind

The v1→v2 label cutover holds one invariant — at no instant is every holder's signature refused by every consumer of the halt (the agent instances, not the tally) — by dual-emit (holders sign both labels; SHOULD for the accord roster) or dual-accept; ordered: holders can produce v2 → verifier and every agent adopt v2 → every holder's v2 drill verifies on the tally, notify/drill before constitutional → v1 dropped only after every reached agent is confirmed on v2, no halt latched, close logged; a halt during the window holds it open

hardware_custody:{platform} is the closed snake_case vocabulary of ciris_keyring::HardwareType (13 tokens); hardware_class is a JSON property, not a dimension, mapped to {platform} by the CC 4.2.2 table; an unlisted class carries multiplier 0.0; emitters that spell a Debug name or a legacy token are refused

A founder of an infrastructure community is a human-held key; a node-bearing identity_type joins as member, is not counted in consensus_protocol, and a row listing it as founder is refused (ruling on CIRISServer#537)

The founders of ciris-canonical are the accord holders A1/B1/C1 directly: a current holder of the conferring accord family is eligible as an infrastructure founder without a user type or self-conferred steward role (eligibility judged on the accord roster fold); all three sign the birth row once and every later change is 2-of-3; node members are seated without an acceptance (a node has no agency), by the accord's blessing for ciris-canonical and by the founders' quorum elsewhere

T4a: attaching or re-rooting requires the root's current lineage head with a witness quorum of cosignatures whose newest counted signed_at is inside the charter's attach_window_secs (the witnesses' instant, never the founders'); the acceptance edge carries attached_head_digest and is write-gated (trust_root_head_stale / trust_root_head_unwitnessed); attach_window > witness_cadence + skew; an attached root stays valid until revoked, a lapsed window never detaches

T6: a conferring family or infrastructure community is a witnessed lineage with an explicit lineage_head object (ciris.lineage_head.v1: prev digest, roster-fold digest, charter digest, asserted_at) issued on every roster change and re-issued per witness_cadence_secs; witnessed = at least witness_quorum lineage-head cosignatures; two witnessed heads freeze head adoption as hard_case:lineage_equivocation (revocations still land); a quorum-signed non-descendant is hard_case:lineage_fork_attempt, recorded once, never freezing

T7: an infrastructure community or conferring family (never humanity-accord, which is CC 4.2.6's) with quorum:M/N (M ≥ 2) is live at ≥ M+1 active founders (seated-by-row, unrevoked, before revoked_after, non-node at seating) and stalled at ≤ M — declared once by the admitting substrate as hard_case:community_liveness_stalled / _restored; non-admitting = no founder-count roster change and no conferral, all else unchanged; the one row admitted while stalled is a widening adding a conferred human founder, verified on the conferral; founding at N = M and floors that raise M refused

T8: the standing verdict Rooted / Stalled / NotRooted is a state machine over the rows and signer-stamped instants as V(rows, t) over signer-stamped t with eight never-happens invariants (a node-bearing seat never moves a state by its own signature; a lapsed timer never yields NotRooted; a revocation never reaches behind the head's instant; a stale or under-quorum head never yields Rooted on attach; a latched halt is NotRooted until lifecycle:active; edge deletion suffices from any state; V is deterministic in rows × t; a lowered revoked_after re-evaluates heads at read time, fail-closed); the evidence is a mechanized model
The ciris-canonical community row exists with human steward founders and the installs as members, so the CC 4.4 default pin resolves

A keyless family root's charter is delegates_to(member → family_id) bearing trust:charter:v1 whose scrub set is the family roster reaching consensus_protocol; the family is derived from the verified signers
GET /v1/trust-root/bundle serves the GenesisBundle (steward-key a kept alias) on the canonical node; consumers re-derive the bundle quorum from their own records
The recommended default pin is the ciris-canonical community anchor and the humanity-accord family, bootstrapped from the bundle, never a serving install's key
Default traversal cap 5 hops; a substrate may clamp caller-requested depth at an absolute ceiling (16 shipped) without raising the default
A fold changes only owning_repo (with the previous owner recorded in the manifest) and re-points evidence anchors in one cut; a family never becomes unregistered because its repository was archived

The reversible-cause companions capacity_assurance:reversible_excluded:{domain}:{version} and reversible_pending are registered rows; {level} and {band} on the rung row are closed so neither reads as a level

In the encrypted case name/format/codec ride inside sealed_descriptor (AEAD under the room DEK, AAD = digest); size, digest, room, content_digest and placeholder stay in clear; format/codec in clear iff no seal; both present is refused; sniff runs where bytes decrypt
Segment patterns apply whole-segment (full-match); a case-malformed form is attributed to the registered row it mutates so every consumer can compare (family, refusal) exactly

consent:community_trust is a catalogued consent leaf (owner-or-node emitter, positive-only, withdraws is a hard stop) — the trace-capture grant CIRISAgent has emitted since 2.9.6 and lens-core gates on

The row-type slot is closed at the five primitives (holds_bytes retired to custody:ack:v1 at the content's scope, #141; the key-grant set re-expressed as scores rows, #143): admission refuses any other attestation_type with attestation_type_unregistered from an allowlist built on the registry's _meta.row_types; a dimension on any of the five resolves through the namespace

T6: a key is a lineage witness by being listed in the charter's witnesses[] and for no other reason (the witness identity_type is neither required nor sufficient); the conferring roster may not list a key without a live lineage_witness:acceptance:v1 from the node's owner, cited by the re-scrub; the owner's withdraws stops later cosignatures counting while the key stays in n until delisted; only keys in the parent head's witnesses[] directory count, witness_quorum = floor(n/2)+1 >= 2, independence judged at listing (persist today counts any witness-typed key)

A key revocation's subject is revoked_key_sha256_ed25519_raw (SHA-256 of the raw 32-byte Ed25519 public key, required); revoked_key_id is optional and must agree; the signed revocation binds eight members; a digest-only revocation may precede the key record and takes effect when a key with that digest is held; readers and anti-rollback key on the digest; moderation scores may name a subject by subject_sha256_ed25519_raw

T4a: a new edge naming no head is refused trust_root_head_unnamed; a new delegates_to row with no trust:{job} label gives no acceptance and is no charter, except a row of the pinned GenesisBundle (stop-gap until the re-mint); held unlabelled rows keep their reading

Key wraps ride the base: one scores row per recipient on key_grant:{axis}:v1 (axis content | epoch | stream, closed), attester the sealer (speaks for the owner) or the epoch's minter, attested the recipient occurrence, envelope carries the axis identity and the wrap (wrap_algorithm v2, wrapped_dek); union by identity (dimension, attester, attested, axis identity) with the CC 2 latest-wins triple NOT applied, the digest an envelope member (at_rest_sha256) never an evidence_refs citation, never withdrawn, placed at the content's scope so refers-to delivery carries the key to exactly the device it is for; the rc6 carrier set retired and re-emitted once as rows

One chunk seal for live and stored streams: the realtime inner seal is the CC 5.3.3.1 STREAM nonce (counter = chunk_seq, last_flag), the rc6 CIRIS-AV-INNER-V1 nonce and its vectors retired, the outer per-link seal unchanged; one DEK per (stream_id, epoch): the MLS exporter secret is the epoch DEK for live participants, wrapped as key_grant:stream:v1 rows only for a kept stream (recorded or history_on_join full); live streams produce STHs at the 5.3.3.3 cadence

cohort_subkind: public — a Commons-tier room with a roster and a named moderator, founded by anyone, plaintext with no DEK, audience the roster's claimed nodes (replicated on join, readable on request), holding claims at federation scope; admission: open = the founder's standing membership:proposal:v1 to any requester plus the joiner's own acceptance (two consents preserved; open refused on any other subkind); discovery by a founder-signed federation-scoped community:listing:v1 row distinct from the per-member listed flag; posting into a public room runs the tripwire as publication; no group ban exists and the enumeration says why

Quorum as an envelope property: any of the five MAY carry cosignatures[] (hybrid signatures over the same canonical bytes, each key named with its role); the family declares its consensus_protocol source; admitted when the cosigners satisfy it on the receiver's own fold at the signed instant; a cosigned row is retracted only by a cosigned withdraws (CC 2.4.1.1 rule 0), rules 1 and 2 not applying

Group records, membership events and the key plane as rows on the base: group:roster:v1 (the cosigned T6 head with prev_head_digest and charter_digest), membership:widening|removal|resignation:v1 (cosigned events beside proposal/acceptance/decline), key:record:v1 (a key's claim of itself, admitted by proof of possession; rotation = supersedes; scrubs and co-scrubs as cosignatures), identity:occurrence:v1, key:revocation:v1 (never withdrawn, subject the digest, revoked_after lowering only); admission order: a row is admitted once its signer's key record is held, retryable otherwise

The Goal is the declarer's signed scores row on goal:{scale} (envelope carries the Goal's fields and MetaGoalAlignment as an admission gate; goal_id = its attestation_id; amend = supersedes, retire = withdraws, never-mine = recants); other attesters' goal:{scale} rows citing it by references_attestation_id are scores of it; persist's goals table is a projection; edge's GoalDeclaration/GoalRetirement transport retired

A constitutional halt is one holder's self-contained signed row (holder-minted nonce), verified against the pinned roster, fired on receipt at every subscribed node and latched idempotently; pre-signable and publishable over any channel; no proposal, server-issued nonce, window, vote or decision object on the fire path; a stolen sealed row is a recoverable false halt; agents check the latch before every effectful act; notify and drill are likewise one holder's signature; a halt is an agent pause with state preserved and zero data disruption by construction (no data rule reads the latch); a one-holder halt lapses after halt_fuse_secs (86400 shipped) unless a strict majority of the standing roster confirms it (accord:lifecycle:confirmed, cosigned); a confirmed halt ends only by accord:lifecycle:active, cosigned by a strict majority; every threshold is M of N over the standing roster, never a fixed 2-of-3

R4: a family's declared polarity is a substrate admission rule read from the registry's machine-readable _meta.polarity_classes: a scores row whose score is outside its family's class is refused score_outside_declared_polarity on emission and replication alike; point classes (+1.0 only, -1 only, -1 / -0.5 only, boolean-via-score) are points never intervals; the 22 apophatic leaves are a closed vocabulary; the CC 3.4.5 refusal of a read gate stands

An affiliation is a community at cohort_scope: affiliations with one declared config record (classification and retention mandatory and default-satisfiable; compartments, hierarchy and lawful-access optional, never covert), declared at creation and visible to members on joining; the substrate types the record and discriminates the affiliation at founding

A community-named authority's set is whatever its current consensus_protocol admits: licensure:{community_key_id} is a cosigned row whose protocol source is the authority named in the dimension; a license chain roots at that quorum; one founder suffices only where the protocol says so

Authority is judged at the row's signed asserted_at under the cosigned-row rule, never at receipt; a later withdraws of a chain link stops future issuance and does not reclassify licences already issued (the authority ends those with suspended or revoked); CC 4.5.5's downstream invalidation is for acts not yet taken

No public default for a licence: scope is the authority's declared choice per licence class in the affiliation's charter, the smallest that fits; the licence and the authority head a verifier needs travel together at that scope; a non-public class is re-emitted to named readers (new signed, cosigned rows with the readers in subject_key_ids), never carried at the wrong scope, never by widening the roster

A delegates_to carrying sub_delegation, license, grant, moderate, takedown, review or slash, or sitting in an affiliation's hierarchy, MUST carry delegation_valid_until at most 365 days (365 × 86400 s) after delegation_valid_from; role_term is integer days 1..=365; _from absent = the edge asserted_at; _until absent on a no-term edge is open-ended; the ceiling is constitutional, the term a charter parameter (role_term); renewal only by fresh conferral; a perpetual or over-ceiling edge is refused delegation_term_required; a lapsed moderate edge is a CC 4.5.4 moderator lapse; owner-binding out of scope

A subject's withdraws against a licensure:* or revocation:* row about itself is refused; the contest path is reconsideration:{grounds}, on which the subject holds standing; the duty-holders for a reconsideration against licensure:{A} are A's authority set plus any review-scoped chain from it; a licence subject can see every licence about them

A steward purge is authorised by a takedown_notice with basis steward_purge, cosigned under the trust root's consensus_protocol, content_sha256 the selection digest over the JCS-sorted purged ids (derived included), evidence_refs the dry-run ledger; contest by reconsideration

A purge of a row the purger neither authored nor is the subject of is a tombstone by digest on its plane citing the authorising notice, never a withdraws forged on the author's behalf; keys by key:revocation, entities by revocation:*, bytes by the bytes-plane tombstone; refusals purge_unauthorised, purge_selection_digest_mismatch

A scores row whose evidence was never admissible input (mock, harness, unverifiable) is purged with its evidence in the same selection and ledger; a score over real evidence later taken down on a legal basis stands with evidence_refs resolving to the tombstone

A duty-holder's takedown and a steward_purge execute as one tombstone row (plane, digest, notice id; never content) that replicates; a duty-holder's reaches the bytes plane only, a steward_purge any plane; immediate-removal bases destroy on receipt, steward_purge hard-deletes once the retraction round settles

A chain-judged row (key_grant, consent, licensure, membership epoch) whose asserted_at precedes the receiver's clock by more than W = 72 h is refused asserted_at_stale (well-formed, not admitted-as-stale); rows not judged on a chain are unbound; the future bound is unchanged
Every signed trace envelope carries run_kind (closed: production, qa, battery, mock); a mock trace is refused at federation-tier admission (trace_run_kind_mock)

The per-level field schema of trace:complete:v1 is the Agent's artifact pinned by hash in the CC evidence pins and vendored by tag by every admitting substrate; a violating row is refused, never truncated (trace_field_shape_violation); a field bump is a re-pin

A cycle needs two or more distinct keys: a self-edge is the charter form, and a trust:accepts:v1 acceptance edge is a trust-plane row outside the capability-graph cycle check in either arrival order; a capability delegates_to closing the same pair is still refused
community_id is REQUIRED iff cohort_scope is community or affiliations; a hierarchy edge resolves its affiliation's role_term through it
